Thanks for the ping — reviewed the attached redline. Two substantive points from Legal that need confirmation from ProcureTech counsel:

1) Liability cap carveout: the proposed language removes Redwood's liability cap for third-party data processing claims. We are open to a limited carveout tied to gross negligence or willful misconduct, but cannot accept an unlimited carveout. Proposed compromise text (we can insert into the doc):

  "Notwithstanding the liability cap set forth in Section 9, neither party shall be liable for claims arising from willful misconduct or gross negligence. Liability for data processing breaches shall be limited to direct damages and shall not exceed the greater of (a) the aggregate fees paid in the 12 months preceding the claim or (b) $2,000,000."

2) Data Processing / Subprocessor transparency: Redwood requires a clause obligating the vendor to provide a list of subprocessors upon request and to notify Redwood of material changes. We can accept a redline that commits to notification and 30 days to raise objections.

If ProcureTech's counsel can confirm acceptance of those two points or propose alternate text, Legal will do a final pass and sign off. Also request: if ProcureTech needs an insurance certificate, indicate limits (we have a standard AM 2.0 cert we can share).

Attaching a short summary of requested edits in the docx (inline comments).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
